facts.fact: The document says Madagascar's cybercrime framework still rests in part on loi n°2014-006, adopted in June 2014, which defined offences such as fraudulent access to information systems and data breaches.

The document says the government tabled projet de loi n°042/2026 on combating cybercrime at the National Assembly on Friday 28 August 2026, with penalties of two to ten years and fines of 100,000 to 100 million ariary.
